data.name: Emmott
data.gender_notes: Emmott is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘Eadmund’, meaning ‘rich in mind or wealth’. This name was popular among Anglo-Saxon kings and saints. Emmott may also have Old English roots meaning ‘rebel’ or ‘emigram’, signifying one who moves from place to place. The name Emmott carries the meaning “Strong one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Emmott usually hope their child will grow to embody strong one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing strength and resilience in the face of challenges.
data.etymology: Emmott belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Emmott total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_greek.name: Εμμόττ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το Εμμόττ είναι όνομα που προέρχεται από την αγγλική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'ο παντοδύναμος'. Η ετυμολογία του ονόματος συνδέεται με έννοιες δύναμης και ικανότητας, που είναι θεμελιώδεις στη χριστιανική παράδοση. Αν και δεν αναφέρεται άμεσα στις Γραφές, το όνομα Εμμόττ αντανακλά την πνευματική σημασία της δύναμης και της προστασίας του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Emmott
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Emmott originem in lingua Anglica habet, significans 'omnipotens' seu 'totius potestatis'. Etymologia nominis ad conceptus potestatis et fortitudinis refertur, qui fundamentum Ecclesiae Christianae sunt. Quamvis non directe in Scripturis sacris appareat, nomen Emmottus spiritualem vim et protectionem Dei reflectit.

in_english.name: Emmott
in_english.long_meaning: The name Emmott originates from English and carries the meaning of 'all-powerful' or 'universal'. While not directly mentioned in the Bible, Emmott symbolizes spiritual strength and divine protection. Historically, it has been used in Christian communities as a testament to faith and omnipotence.

data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Emmott is reminiscent of St. Edmund, the patron saint of England. The spiritual significance of the name Emmott lies in its association with resilience, perseverance, and unwavering devotion to one's faith amidst adversity.
